methods.label: Recognize an equilateral triangle
methods.explanation: Since \(AB=AD\) and \(\angle BAD=60^\circ\), \(\triangle ABD\) is equilateral, so \(AB=BD=5\). The perimeter is \(4\times5=20\).
methods.levelReason: Equal rhombus sides and the 60° isosceles-triangle criterion are both Grade 8 knowledge.
